layers.name: Backtesting Engine
layers.description: The simulation core: the System orchestrator and processing stages (raw data, forecasting rules, scaling/capping, combining, position sizing, portfolio, accounts/P&L, risk) plus Rob Carver's provided example systems and trading rules.

layers.name: Quant Math
layers.description: Quantitative estimation and portfolio optimisation utilities: volatility/correlation/mean estimators, handcrafting, shrinkage, and weight optimisers that power forecast scaling and position sizing.

layers.name: Domain Models
layers.description: Core domain objects modelling the trading universe: futures contracts, instruments, multiple/adjusted prices, positions, spreads, rolls, fills, and trading hours.

layers.name: Data Access & Storage
layers.description: Abstract data interfaces and their CSV/Mongo/Arctic/Parquet backends, config loading, and simulation data sources that feed both the backtest and production systems.

layers.name: Broker Integration
layers.description: Interactive Brokers connectivity via ib_async: the IB client, adapters, and broker-data abstractions for prices, FX, contracts, positions, and order translation.

layers.name: Order Execution
layers.description: Live order and execution management: instrument/contract/broker order stacks, execution algos, the stack handler workflow, and strategy order generation.

layers.name: Production Orchestration
layers.description: Live trading orchestration: run/update processes, reporting, backups, data facades, Linux launcher scripts, and the process-control/scheduling layer (syscontrol).

layers.name: Data Initialization
layers.description: One-off setup and migration scripts for seeding price data, building roll calendars, stitching multiple/adjusted prices, and transferring data between storage backends.

layers.name: Logging & Diagnostics
layers.description: Structured logging adapters, handlers, filters, and the diagnostics stack including email alerting and database-backed log/email control.

layers.name: Core Utilities
layers.description: Low-level shared helpers underpinning every package: pandas utilities, date/maths helpers, general utils, the interactive console, file utilities, and caching.

layers.name: Web Dashboard
layers.description: Flask web application for monitoring the live system, with its HTML templates, CSS, and JavaScript front-end assets.

layers.name: Examples, Tutorials & Tests
layers.description: Tutorial and example scripts, the user's personal learning notebooks and notes, ad-hoc data tools, and the top-level integration test suites.

layers.name: Documentation, Config & CI
layers.description: Project documentation (markdown guides and doc generators), root-level packaging/build/tooling config, GitHub Actions CI workflows, and analysis tooling config.
